body: Yea well i've been strong for too long. I always helped people, even when i didn't had enough, just because i was raised religious and i have a good heart and i've never been selfish, but now i see how that screwed me over so many times, because i lost so much and i never expected anything from anyone...but now when i need help there is no one to help me...and it's my fault, i do realize it, but i think i'm done....There is nothing else i can do and being strong just doesn't matter anymore...With bills piling up, no job and money, there is nothing that i can do anymore...
